Michigan Secretary of State, 2022 Michigan Election Results (County Results, OFFICIAL)

method: pipeline/patches/2022_MI_GOV_wayne.py sums the Governor (office code 2) rows for WAYNE from the official county file; Democratic -> dem, Republican -> rep, Libertarian, US Taxpayers, Green, Natural Law and write-ins -> oth.
validation: Wayne County (26163) official: Whitmer 457,601, Dixon 180,487, others 7,651 (total 645,739) vs MIT 426,657 / 168,044 (total 606,273): MIT was -6.76% D / -6.89% R. State after filling: dem 2,432,125 / rep 1,960,829 vs official statewide 2,430,505 / 1,960,635: +0.07% / +0.01%.
